edges.reason: Constructor assigns the Uniswap router address.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair.
Constructor marks owner, contract and marketing as fee-exempt.
Constructor initialises the preTrader whitelist entry.
renounceOwnership sets the privileged _owner address to zero.
onlyOwner modifier compares _msgSender() with _owner before renouncing.
balanceOf reads the account reflection balance.
tokenFromReflection divides rAmount by the current rate.
transfer forwards to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom reads and rewrites the caller allowance.
Auto-swap is performed inside _transfer before the sender balance is debited.
ETH payout to marketing runs inside the transfer flow before balance updates.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
_transfer selects and writes the active redistribution fee.
_transfer selects and writes the active tax fee.
Blacklist mapping gates whether the transfer is allowed.
preTrader whitelist gates transfers while trading is closed.
inSwap guard is read to prevent nested swaps.
swapEnabled flag gates the automatic swap.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount and swap size.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline (timestamp dependency).
swapTokensForEth calls WETH/swap on the router.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap with amountOutMin = 0.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap while the swap executes.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to an external marketing address.
onlyOwner restricts who may enable trading.
manualswap reads the contract token balance.
manualsend pushes the whole contract ETH balance out.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient reflection balances.
_transferStandard performs SafeMath sub/add on reflection balances.
_takeTeam multiplies tTeam by the current rate.
_getTValues multiplies and divides to derive tFee/tTeam.
_getRValues multiplies amounts by the current rate.
